tasks.title: Доска: хранилище и SPM
tasks.statement: На доске вы собираете окружение oVirt вокруг хранилища. В четырёх сценариях: пережить потерю главного домена, подготовить преемника SPM, починить машину, чей хост не видит её диск, и подключить домен iSCSI, которому нужна своя сеть хранения. Статусы выводятся из связей, а кнопки «Путь сообщения» показывают путь команды. Упражнение решено, когда цели всех сценариев выполнены.
tasks.hint: Хост должен видеть каждый домен, подключённый к его дата-центру. Главный домен — первый подключённый; при его потере его место занимает следующий. SPM — один из хостов Up, поэтому для отказоустойчивости их нужно минимум два. Домену iSCSI нужна сеть с ролью «хранение» на каждом хосте.

scenarios.title: Lose the master domain
scenarios.story: The data center lives on one NFS domain, and it is the master. If that domain fails, the data center goes down. When there is a second domain, the next attached one takes over as the master.
scenarios.goal: After losing any single storage domain the data center stays Up and keeps an SPM
scenarios.hint: Add a second domain, attach it to the data center and connect it to every host: a host that does not see an attached domain becomes NonOperational.

scenarios.title: The SPM needs a successor
scenarios.story: One host in the data center runs the SPM role and is the only one to change the storage metadata. With a single host, losing it takes the whole data center down. Add a second host.
scenarios.goal: After losing any single host the data center stays Up and keeps an SPM
scenarios.hint: A new host needs everything the first one has: membership in the cluster, the management network and the storage domain.

scenarios.title: The VM does not start
scenarios.story: The VM keeps its disk on the second domain. Its host does not see that domain: the host is NonOperational and the VM is down. Select the host to read the reason.
scenarios.goal: Everything works and the VM can be started
scenarios.hint: A host has to see every domain attached to its data center, not only the master.

scenarios.title: An iSCSI domain needs a storage network
scenarios.story: Add a block domain over iSCSI. Unlike NFS it needs a path of its own: the hosts have to have a network with the storage role, otherwise they cannot log in to the target and become NonOperational.
scenarios.goal: An iSCSI domain is attached and everything keeps working
scenarios.hint: Select the new domain and set its type to iSCSI. Then give the hosts a network with the storage role: define it in the data center, attach it to the cluster and assign it to every host.

tasks.title: Доска: хранилище, уровень 2
tasks.statement: Соберите на доске окружение, где хранилище работает по-настоящему: пять сценариев. Домен подключён к дата-центру, но хосты его не видят. Домен с диском машины вообще не подключён. Второй дата-центр не может пользоваться чужим доменом. Домен Inactive, хотя хосты его видят, потому что хосты не Up по другим причинам. Дата-центр с запасом и по хостам, и по доменам. Упражнение решено, когда решены все сценарии.
tasks.hint: Домен Active, только пока его видит хост Up; хост Up, только если видит все домены своего дата-центра и имеет все нужные сети. Читайте причину в статусе хоста и помните: домен принадлежит одному дата-центру.

scenarios.title: Attached, but nobody sees it
scenarios.story: The NFS domain is attached to the data center, yet the domain shows Inactive, the data center is NonResponsive and all three hosts are NonOperational. Select a host and read its status.
scenarios.goal: All three hosts are Up and the data center has an SPM
scenarios.hint: Attaching a domain to the data center is only half of the job: every host of that data center has to be connected to the domain as well.

scenarios.title: A domain nobody attached
scenarios.story: The VM db-1 keeps its disk on the domain nfs-archive. The domain exists, but it is Unattached, so db-1 stays down while web-1 on the other domain runs fine.
scenarios.goal: Both VMs run and can be started, and both domains serve the data center
scenarios.hint: A domain serves a data center only after it is attached to it, and then every host of that data center has to be connected to it, otherwise that host turns NonOperational.

scenarios.title: A domain belongs to one data center
scenarios.story: The Berlin data center has a host but no storage of its own and shows Uninitialized. The VM web-1 runs in Berlin, but its disk is on the domain of the Paris data center, so it cannot start.
scenarios.goal: Both data centers are Up and web-1 runs from a domain of its own data center
scenarios.hint: A storage domain is attached to one data center only and cannot be shared. Look at which data center the domain of the disk belongs to.

scenarios.title: Connected, yet Inactive
scenarios.story: The domain is attached and connected to both hosts, yet it shows Inactive and the data center is NonResponsive. The storage itself looks fine, and the two hosts have different statuses.
scenarios.goal: Both hosts are Up with every network of the cluster, and the data center has an SPM
scenarios.hint: A domain is Active only while an Up host sees it, and every host is judged on its own. Read the reason of each host separately.

scenarios.title: Spare hosts and spare domains
scenarios.story: The data center runs web-1 on one host and one domain. Either of them is a single point of failure: lose it, and the data center and the VM go down.
scenarios.goal: web-1 runs, and after losing any single host or any single domain the data center stays Up with an SPM
scenarios.hint: A new host needs the cluster, the management network and every domain. A new domain must be attached and connected to every host. Count what is left after each loss.

tasks.title: Доска: хранилище, уровень 3
tasks.statement: Доведите блочное хранилище iSCSI до рабочего состояния: пять сценариев. Одна сеть хранения обслуживает несколько доменов iSCSI. У сети назначена не та роль. Новый хост должен получить всё, что есть у остальных. Машина с диском на LUN стартует, только когда цепочка собрана на её хосте целиком. Смена типа домена на iSCSI ломает хост, который с ним не работал. Упражнение решено, когда решены все сценарии.
tasks.hint: Как только в дата-центре есть домен iSCSI, каждому его хосту нужна сеть с ролью хранения: подключённая к кластеру и назначенная хосту. Читайте причины в статусе хоста и идите по цепочке запуска машины шаг за шагом.

scenarios.title: One storage network for every LUN
scenarios.story: Two iSCSI domains were attached next to the NFS one and all three hosts went NonOperational. A storage network is defined in the data center, but the hosts do not use it yet.
scenarios.goal: All three hosts are Up and the iSCSI domains keep their type
scenarios.hint: A host needs a network with the storage role, not one network per domain: a single one serves every iSCSI domain. A network can be assigned to a host only after it is attached to the cluster.

scenarios.title: The network has the wrong role
scenarios.story: An iSCSI domain was added and its network iscsi-net is attached to the cluster. Host-1 has the network assigned, yet both hosts are NonOperational.
scenarios.goal: Both hosts are Up and the iSCSI domain works
scenarios.hint: For an iSCSI domain a host needs a network with the storage role, not just any network: check the properties of the network. Then check which hosts it is assigned to.

scenarios.title: A new host needs everything
scenarios.story: A third host has just been installed and added to the board, but it belongs to no cluster. The other two hosts work and the data center is Up.
scenarios.hint: Compare the new host with a working one: it needs the cluster, every network of the cluster and every storage domain. After each step, the status of the host lists what is still missing.

scenarios.title: The VM on a LUN will not start
scenarios.story: The VM db-1 keeps its disk on the iSCSI domain lun-data and refuses to start. Its host is NonOperational, while host-1 and web-1 are fine.
scenarios.goal: Both VMs run and every VM can be started
scenarios.hint: Follow the start of the VM hop by hop: the first failing step is not the only one. A host that works with an iSCSI domain needs the domain and also a storage network.

scenarios.title: Converting a domain to iSCSI
scenarios.story: The archive array moves from NFS to iSCSI. An optional storage network is already prepared on the two hosts that work with the archive, and the third host only runs VMs from the other domain.
scenarios.goal: The archive domain is iSCSI and all three hosts stay Up
scenarios.hint: Change the type of the domain in the inspector, then watch the host statuses: the storage network requirement applies to every host of the data center, also to the ones that never touch that domain.
